title: Prevented empty selector lanes from narrowing downstream retrieval
points: Router guidance now treats broad sector initiative searches, such as capacity expansions and commissioning timelines, as independent announcement and filing retrieval rather than a selector-gated chain.
Narrative lane instructions now require selected tickers to be backed by selected source pages or announcements.
The orchestrator now ignores selected ticker handoffs from lanes with no evidence rows or pages, preventing empty selector results from dropping downstream company coverage.

keystones.name: empty narrative selectors cannot narrow filings
